parameters.subject: =New Appointment: {{ $json.patientName }} — {{ $json.appointmentDate }} at {{ $json.appointmentTime }}
=Reminder: Your appointment tomorrow at {{ $json['Time'] }}
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $json['Patient Name'] }},

This is a friendly reminder that you have an appointment scheduled for tomorrow.

Appointment Details:
- Doctor: {{ $json['Doctor'] }}
- Date: {{ $json['Date'] }}
- Time: {{ $json['Time'] }}
- Type: {{ $json['Type'] }}
- Booking ID: {{ $json['Booking ID'] }}

Please remember to:
- Arrive 10 minutes early
- Bring a valid photo ID
- Bring your insurance card if applicable

Need to cancel or reschedule? Please contact us at least 24 hours in advance at [CLINIC_PHONE].

We look forward to seeing you!

Warm regards,
The Clinic Team
[CLINIC_ADDRESS]

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, bookingId: $json.bookingId, message: 'Appointment confirmed! Check your email for details.' }) }}
